[PREFERENCE] User wants to know must-try dishes in Japan and Korea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Japan must-try dishes: Sushi, Ramen, Tonkatsu, Yakitori, Udon, Tempura, Okonomiyaki, Bento.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korea must-try dishes: Bibimbap, Bulgogi, Jeyuk bokkeum, Naengmyeon, Kimchi Stew (Kimchi Jjigae), Tteokbokki, Galbi, Mandu.

[EVENT] User has been perfecting their homemade ramen recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ramen is a popular dish with rich broth, springy noodles, and various toppings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User might want to try different regional variations of ramen in Japan: Tonkotsu Ramen, Shio Ramen, Shoyu Ramen, Miso Ramen.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User could consider making their own ramen from scratch in Japan, using local ingredients and techniques.  
[PREFERENCE] User's go-to ramen recipe includes extra pork belly and boiled eggs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pork belly is called "chashu" in Japanese, and boiled eggs are called "ajitama."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chashu is typically braised in a sweet soy sauce-based sauce, and ajitama is marinated in a sweet soy sauce-based sauce.  
[PREFERENCE] User is obsessed with bulgogi and galbi.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Korean BBQ is a social and flavorful experience, with marinated meats and banchan.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bulgogi means "fire meat" and is made with thinly sliced beef marinated in a sweet and savory sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Galbi refers to marinated short ribs, grilled to perfection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should try other popular BBQ dishes like Samgyeopsal, Dakgalbi, and Jeyuk bokkeum.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should explore all-you-can-eat BBQ options and table-top grilling experiences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should try various banchan like kimchi, japchae, and bok
